name: Offer to find the Lumbridge outlaws

evidence.note: Ask Captain Harlan about the robbery outside the general store.

name: Ask Mudfoot about the stolen goods

evidence.note: Talk to Mudfoot in blue armour by the ruined cottage south of the cow field.

name: Confront the outlaw at the general store

evidence.note: Return to the shop, confront the outlaw and follow the cutscene.

name: Defeat the archer and retrieve the bow

evidence.note: Talk to Mudfoot by the windmill chicken field. Stab is effective here. Pick up the shortbow and bronze arrows. Incidental combat XP and ammunition or rune use are variable.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Defeat the archer and collect the ranged equipment.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow extra time and bring suitable gear and food.

name: Defeat the mage by the H.A.M. hideout

evidence.note: Talk to Mudfoot outside the hideout and defeat the second outlaw. Ranged is effective. Pick up the staff. Incidental combat XP and ammunition or rune use are variable.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Defeat the mage and collect the staff.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow extra time and bring suitable gear and food.

name: Defeat the warrior in Lumbridge graveyard

evidence.note: Confront the warrior in the graveyard. He uses Protect from Melee. Cast a combat spell or use a bow. Pick up the iron scimitar. Incidental combat XP and ammunition or rune use are variable.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Defeat the warrior and collect the scimitar.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow extra time and bring suitable gear and food.

name: Share the bounty with Mudfoot

evidence.note: Talk to Captain Harlan to complete the quest. Receive your 500-coin share and four 500 XP combat lamps.

name: Ask Betty about the murder

evidence.note: Talk to Betty and get Sergeant Hudson's permission to investigate.

name: Inspect the Land's End crime scene

evidence.note: Inspect the body and blood, read the letter and search the shelves for the newspaper cutting.

name: Question Lan and Hugor

evidence.note: Speak to Lan and Hugor. Inspect the bloody knife.

name: Report the evidence to Betty and Hudson

evidence.note: Read the Land's End clues, talk to Betty and report back to Sergeant Hudson.

name: Investigate Betty's uncle's house

evidence.note: Climb through the west window, let Betty in, then inspect the cellar, bookcase and compost bin.

name: Question the witnesses and escape the cell

evidence.note: Question Joyce and the monk, read the clues and continue into the arrest cutscene. Pull the plank from the cell wall and climb out into Port Piscarilius.

name: Investigate Captain Jensen's house

evidence.note: Inspect the body, drawers, bed and wardrobe.

name: Return to the jail and inspect the blood

evidence.note: Climb back through the opening and inspect the blood in the jail before travelling to Shayzien.

name: Follow Hudson's lead from the Shayzien war tent

evidence.note: Visit the Shayzien Encampment and watch the cutscene that moves the player to the crime scene approach.

name: Investigate the Shayzien house and speak to Kyle

evidence.note: Inspect the body, shelves and blood. Talk to Kyle and Sergeant Hudson.

name: Solve the island cipher and finish the investigation

evidence.note: Inspect the plant between the trees, descend through the trapdoor and solve the cipher. The last cutscene returns the player to the island and awards the amulet.

name: Offer to collect bees for Farmer Bea

evidence.note: Talk to Farmer Bea at her farm on the ridge east of Varrock's south-east mine.

name: Get the bee box from the Varrock dealer

evidence.note: Talk to the bee dealer by the Grand Exchange and accept the box.

name: Carry the box to Farmer Bea and get the wasp equipment

evidence.note: Keep the insects settled on the way back and give the box to Bea. After the hive scene, take the repellent and use the protective hat and net.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Bring the box back to Bea.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Check and shake the box as prompted on the return trip and follow Bea's dialogue.

name: Calm and net the wasps

evidence.note: Wear the bee hat, spray furious wasps and catch enough calm wasps with the net for Bea. Food helps if the swarms sting the player.

name: Report to Bea and collect a bird snare

evidence.note: Show Bea the stings. Follow the hive scene and take the snare for the bird trapping lesson.

name: Trap honey buzzards and gather feathers

evidence.note: Set, check and reset a bird snare in the nearby Hunter field until enough feathers have been caught.

name: Fletch the quest darts and show them to Bea

evidence.note: Combine the stings and feathers, then show the darts to Bea. The required catch quantities are included in these quest stages.

name: Finish Bea's farm lesson

evidence.note: Finish the last hive scene and speak to Bea to unlock both wasp swarms, both honey buzzards and the dart exchange.

name: Exchange 35 wasp darts for Bea's supplies

evidence.note: Use Bea's Swap-darts menu after the quest. The bag contains variable supplies.

name: Exchange 20 killer wasp darts for Bea's supplies

evidence.note: Use Bea's Swap-darts menu after the quest. The bag contains variable supplies.

name: Pick up the local bronze axe

evidence.note: Pick up the local axe from the quest material area if needed. The axe tier and tile are estimates.

name: Speak to the juvenile snail

evidence.note: Wade to the small island east of Canifis and talk to the snail.

name: Collect fresh leaves

evidence.note: Get a pile of fresh leaves from the nearby trees.

name: Feed the snail and defeat the leech

evidence.note: Bring the leaves to the snail and defeat the level-39 leech that appears. Speak to the snail after the fight.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Feed the snail and defeat the leech.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow extra time and bring suitable gear and food.

name: Cut a dew-covered branch

evidence.note: Use an axe on the nearby trees to cut a dew-covered branch.

name: Strip the dew-covered branch

evidence.note: Strip the branch to collect restorative dew.

name: Treat and name the snail

evidence.note: Apply the restorative dew and choose a name for the snail.

name: Gather strong sticks for the shelter

evidence.note: Cut the dry sticks needed for the shelter from the nearby trees.

name: Build the snail's shelter

evidence.note: Use the sticks at the island to construct a shelter beside the snail.

name: Defeat SnelmLover500

evidence.note: Confront and defeat the level-50 hunter who threatens the snail.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Defeat SnelmLover500 and protect the snail.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow extra time and bring suitable gear and food.

name: Return to the snail and receive the pink snelm

evidence.note: Speak to the juvenile snail to finish the quest and receive the cosmetic shell.

name: Buy another amulet of sight from Sergeant Hudson

evidence.note: Jagex confirms the separate Hudson sale. Catalog models one purchase at the Shayzien Encampment. Verify his standing tile and price in game.
